text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm not tired. Besides, this is no 
time to be fussing over me."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not yet—it all starts from here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's get going already.

Maintaining her cool demeanor, Narita 
Taishin's footing was vastly more solid 
than it had been before the race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So, about the next race we're targeting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
What else is there to talk about, huh? You 
haven't had enough kicks to the ribs yet?

The blow I took when getting scolded 
before the race was still stinging, so I 
hastily shook my head.

Of course, if I had taken a kick at full 
power, I'd be in the hospital without 
question, so I believe she held back quite 
a bit, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Never mind that, let's talk about the 
next race. ...Or rather, let's talk about 
the future."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm aiming for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna prove everyone who mocked me 
wrong, a half-baked race just isn't gonna 
cut it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho... On a stage where the 
strongest gather, all we can do is win, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll win and make them acknowledge me. 
...Definitely.

Even so, the Satsuki Sho is still a long 
way off. For now, I'd like her to run in 
Junior-class races and gain some 
experience.
And then—
choice_data_list:
First, why don't we run in the Hopeful 
Stakes?

First, how about running in the Hopeful 
Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...A Junior Class GⅠ race?

The Hopeful Stakes is a Nakayama 2000m 
turf race, just like the Satsuki Sho.

I told her that getting a feel for things 
here would surely serve as great 
experience, and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Mm, got it. Next up is the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...If I'm entering, I'm going to win.

And so, adjustments got underway in 
preparation for running in the Hopeful 
Stakes!
